heading: Correlations are data
text:
### Correlations are data [LTSL.7.7]

An author's `as` value is deterministic ([LDET], no RNG), so it is knowable at
compile time and is written explicitly on the `for call` key; a reply may omit
its `corr` slot ([LTSL.7.2]). A call with no `as` carries a generated correlation
([LCRS.3.1]), and a stub keys on its arguments ([LTSL.7.2]).
